sonnet.problem: The true/false statement bundles two claims: letting the fields lie fallow every seventh year, and canceling every debt. A baker can't tell which one is being tested.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The card says lots were cast 'to decide which families bring' the wood. Verse 34 says only that lots were cast 'for the donation of wood by our families at the appointed times each year'. It does not say what the lots decided, so the card adds a purpose the text leaves open.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
